description: This PHP source file defines a controller class for the 'Location' management within the OpenCart admin panel. It handles actions like listing locations, displaying forms for adding/editing locations, saving updates, and deleting locations, with routing, permissions checks, data preparation, and view rendering.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Controller class for managing location entities in the admin interface, including listing, adding, editing, saving, and deleting locations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Entry point for the location management page; loads language, sets page title, prepares breadcrumbs, and renders the main location view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX or direct requests to return the list of locations in a view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves location data with pagination, builds URLs, and returns the HTML view for the location list.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a location, pre-filling data when editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates user permissions and input, then adds or updates a location record in the database, returning JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes selected location records after permission check, responding with success or error in JSON.
